Resubmitted with the verifier's repairs applied.

**Changes made in response to feedback:**
1. **§10.3.A minimality repaired** — "during the Term" is restored verbatim; the edit now adds only the qualifier "and subject to Customer's reduction right in Section 8.1A". The eight-year sole-sourcing period is no longer shortened, so no exclusivity concession outside the MINCOMMIT checklist and no duplication of the 12-month cap.
2. **Cross-reference hygiene** — the inserted clause now carries its designation inside the operative text ("8.1A Minimum Commitment. …"), so the §10.3.A citation to Section 8.1A resolves rather than dangling.
3. **elementCoverage rebuilt** — 12-month cap and true-up map to operation 1 only; the 30-day reduction right maps to operations 1 and 2 (the qualifier is what makes the right effective against §10.3.A).

**Level:** fallback, position-complete in operative language. Preferred is not claimed — the Monthly Base Fee minimum and advance-payment mechanic remain, so Customer does not pay for usage only. The retained Estimated Remaining Value formula is noted in the rationale as a termination-fee issue for the termination rule, not a shortfall penalty under this rule.
